regression_scope_note: The complete matrix used the preceding graphics build; final graphics source adds prominent modification notices and is requalified separately in both boot profiles. Normal runtime implementation is unchanged. Clean downloadable-media hashes and checks are supplied separately with the publication.

host_reference.source_difference: Original Cairo plus the PostScript gating patch; the bounded debug-formatting change affects an unused debug helper, not these rendering operations

repository_tests.compiler_header_followup: After the compiler-only alloca header, focused host/sanitizer and actual native stdlib tests pass; all previous SDK library files remain byte-identical.

header_export.change: Added compiler-only alloca.h; no runtime library code or ABI layout changed

retained_build_failures.diagnosis: Nested manual/Meson linker groups made genuine link probes fail. Removed manual groups; real pthread and C11 atomic probes pass, no no-mutex mode.
Missing real allocated string-copy API; implemented and tested actual owned copies and static recursive initializer.
Private PostScript spool helper compiled even with PostScript disabled. Explicit backend gating patch; no fabricated temporary-file API.
Unused recording debug helper required sprintf; port uses existing bounded snprintf with actual remaining capacity.
Missing compiler alloca header; provided real compiler builtin, native alignment/storage check and existing stack ownership/guards.
Meson wrapper absent from command PATH; fixed prepared command PATH. Build tool now records executable-not-found errors as failed builds.
